mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.sort ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.permission_type, p.parent_id, p.path, p.component, p.icon, p.status, p.sort, p.create_id, p.create_name, p.create_time, p.update_id, p.update_name, p.update_time, p.deleted, p.delete_id, p.delete_name, p.delete_time FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.permission_type = 1 ORDER BY p.sort ASC
SELECT * FROM sys_permission WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort ASC

SELECT id, permission_name, permission_code, permission_type, parent_id, path, component, icon, status, sort, create_id, create_name, create_time, update_id, update_name, update_time, deleted, delete_id, delete_name, delete_time FROM sys_permission WHERE deleted = 0 AND parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC

#{pid}
